note: Load form (research/load-harness.md) for L05: heap kept per request, judged on the heap slope (the owner, 19 November 2026): through each measured step the twin's heap is read after a full collection about every 2 s, with the responses answered so far, and fitted by least squares. Each judged route first gets a warm-up step (pools, compiled code and every bounded store filled past its bound), then the measured step, with keys the warm-up did not use (k6 numbers each step's requests from 1). A twin reports when its slope is positive in every repeat and its median slope is at least 50 bytes a request and three times the other twin's; the finding is gated on the spread of the slopes over the repeats (10% or less), not on the load average. The bounded suggestion cache and the order lines are the decoys. createOrder is an expected miss: the audit list keeps one small order per request, about 1.6 times what the clean twin's own heap keeps per request on the same route (CI run 44609939663), under the measure's floor of three times; it stays as the hard case. placeCart, an idempotency store that keeps each cart, is the leak above the floor that must be caught. searchProducts runs 30 s, for more heap points: at 15 s its slopes spread 23.5% over five repeats (CI run 44663453947). The form runs alone in its own CI job (load-long) under the ci-long caps, 2,400 s of load a run, so it does not run at the cap. Each step runs at a fixed arrival rate (k6), the twins in alternating order over the repeats (pairs). defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other judged step is a decoy, in both twins.
